description: A quantizer that snaps an incoming pitch to a scale you type into the panel, one value in cents per line

inputs.text: The pitch to be quantized, read at 1200 cents per volt

outputs.text: The pitch snapped to the nearest value in the typed scale

notes: the module has no knobs; the scale is set only by typing into the text area that fills the panel, and that text area cannot be clicked for help
type one number per line, in cents above the root, in rising order; the root at 0 cents is always there and is not typed, and the last line is the period at which the scale repeats
a new module comes up holding 100 through 1200 in steps of 100, which is the ordinary twelve-tone equal-tempered octave
text that does not parse into at least two numbers, or whose last number is not above zero, is thrown away and the last scale that did parse carries on working
a line that is not a number at all is skipped rather than treated as zero
the typed scale is saved and reloaded with the patch
one channel in and one channel out; a polyphonic cable into the pitch input is reduced to its first channel

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous · one channel only

unpatched it reads 0V.
